arxiv-2212-06702.title: A Search for Coincident Neutrino Emission from Fast Radio Bursts with Seven Years of IceCube Cascade Events
arxiv-2212-06702.creator: R. Abbasi, M. Ackermann, J. Adams, N. Aggarwal, J. A. Aguilar, M. Ahlers, J.M. Alameddine, A. A. Alves Jr, N. M. Amin, K. Andeen, T. Anderson, G. Anton, C. Argüelles, Y. Ashida, S. Athanasiadou, S. N. Axani, X. Bai, A. Balagopal V, M. Baricevic, S. W. Barwick, V. Basu, R. Bay, J. J. Beatty, K.-H. Be
arxiv-2212-06702.description: Abstract This paper presents the results of a search for neutrinos that are spatially and temporally coincident with 22 unique, non-repeating Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) and one repeating FRB (FRB121102). FRBs are a rapidly growing class of Galactic and extragalactic astrophysical objects that are considered a potential source of high-energy neutrinos.

arxiv-2304-05615.title: Deep Stable Multi-Interest Learning for Out-of-distribution Sequential Recommendation
arxiv-2304-05615.creator: Qiang Liu, Zhaocheng Liu, Zhenxi Zhu, Shu Wu, and Liang Wang
arxiv-2304-05615.description: Abstract Recently, multi-interest models, which extract interests of a user as multiple representation vectors, have shown promising performances for sequential recommendation. However, none of existing multi-interest recommendation models consider the Out-Of-Distribution (OOD) generalization problem, in which interest distribution may change.

arxiv-2305-16096.description: Abstract . By the uniformization theorem of [ 24 ] , any A ​ L ​ H ∗ ALH^{*} -gravitational instanton ( X , g ) (X,g) can be compactified to a weak del Pezzo surface Y Y as a complex manifold by adding a smooth anti-canonical divisor D D .

arxiv-2306-02146.title: Finite-frequency noise, Fano factor, Δ ​ T \Delta T -noise and cross-correlations in double quantum dots
arxiv-2306-02146.creator: A. Crépieux, T.Q. Duong, M. Lavagna
arxiv-2306-02146.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by A. Crépieux, T.Q. Duong, M. Lavagna. A theoretical study on electrical current fluctuations in a double quantum dot connected to electronic reservoirs is presented, with the aim of deriving the finite-frequency noise, the Fano factor and the Δ ​ T \Delta T -noise. We establish a general expression for the noise in terms of Green functions in the double quantum dot and self-energies in the reservoirs. This result is then applied to model double quantum dots in various situations.

arxiv-2412-04823.title: Noncommutative complex analytic geometry of a contractive quantum plane
arxiv-2412-04823.creator: Anar Dosi
arxiv-2412-04823.description: Abstract . In the paper we investigate the Banach space representations of Manin’s quantum q q -plane for | q | ≠ 1 \left|q\right|\neq 1 . The Arens-Michael envelope of the quantum plane is extended up to a Fréchet algebra presheaf over its spectrum.

arxiv-2503-03155.creator: Srinivas V. Mandyam 1, Weicen Dong 2,3, Xiaoxian Yan 4,5, Binru Zhao 2,4, Junfa Lin 6, Tianlong Xia 6,7,8, Zhiying Zhao 9, Xi Chen 10, Jie Ma 4,11, Hui Xing 4,5, F. Malte Grosche 12, Matteo Baggioli 2,3

Mandyam 1, Weicen Dong 2,3, Xiaoxian Yan 4,5, Binru Zhao 2,4, Junfa Lin 6, Tianlong Xia 6,7,8, Zhiying Zhao 9, Xi Chen 10, Jie Ma 4,11, Hui Xing 4,5, F. Malte Grosche 12, Matteo Baggioli 2,3. Nowotny chimney ladder (NCL) crystals present physical properties in between the contrasting paradigms of ideal crystal and amorphous solid, making them promising candidates for thermoelectric applications due to their inherently low thermal conductivity.

arxiv-2508-11227.title: High-dimensional maximum-entropy phase space tomography Thanks: This manuscript has been authored by UT-Battelle, LLC, under Contract No. DE-AC05-00OR22725 with the U.S. Department of Energy. The United States Government retains, and the publisher, by accepting the article for publication, acknowled
arxiv-2508-11227.creator: A. Hoover, Oak Ridge National Laboratory, Oak Ridge, TN, USA
arxiv-2508-11227.description: Abstract Reconstructing 4D or 6D phase space distributions from 1D or 2D measurements is a challenging inverse problem encountered in particle accelerators. Entropy maximization is an established method to incorporate prior information in the reconstruction, but it is typically infeasible in high-dimensional spaces. In this paper, I review two recent approaches to high-dimensional entropy maximization.

arxiv-2509-09645.title: Explaining the Reputational Risks of AI-Mediated Communication: Messages Labeled as AI-Assisted Are Viewed as Less Diagnostic of the Sender’s Moral Character
arxiv-2509-09645.creator: Pranav Khadpe, Kimi Wenzel, George Loewenstein, Geoff Kaufman
arxiv-2509-09645.description: Abstract When someone sends us a thoughtful message, we naturally form judgments about their character. But what happens when that message carries a label indicating it was written with the help of AI? This paper investigates how the appearance of AI assistance affects our perceptions of message senders.

arxiv-2511-04032.title: Detecting Silent Failures in Multi-Agentic AI Trajectories
arxiv-2511-04032.creator: Divya Pathak, Harshit Kumar, Anuska Roy, Felix George, Mudit Verma, Pratibha Moogi
arxiv-2511-04032.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Divya Pathak, Harshit Kumar, Anuska Roy, Felix George, Mudit Verma, Pratibha Moogi. Multi-Agentic AI systems, powered by large language models (LLMs), are inherently non-deterministic and prone to silent failures such as drift, cycles, and missing details in outputs, which are difficult to detect. We introduce the task of anomaly detection in agentic trajectories to identify these failures and present a dataset curation pipeline that captures user behavior, agent non-determinism, and LLM variation.

arxiv-2512-24446.title: Generative forecasting with joint probability models Journal: arXiv
arxiv-2512-24446.creator: Patrick Wyrod, Ashesh Chattopadhyay, Daniele Venturi
arxiv-2512-24446.description: Abstract Chaotic dynamical systems exhibit strong sensitivity to initial conditions and often contain unresolved multiscale processes, making deterministic forecasting fundamentally limited. Generative models offer an appealing alternative by learning distributions over plausible system evolutions; yet, most existing approaches focus on next-step conditional prediction rather than the structure of the underlying dynamics.

britannica-1911-cash.title: Cash (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-cash.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-cash.description: Article 'Cash' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 5), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. The “cash on delivery” or “collect on delivery” system, known as C.O.D., is one whereby a tradesman can, through a delivery agency, send goods to a customer, and have the money due to him collected on the delivery of the same, with a guarantee from the carrier that, if no money be collected, the goods shall be returned.

pmc-11413096.title: Optimizing photosynthetic light-harvesting under stars: simple and general antenna models
pmc-11413096.creator: Samir Chitnavis, Callum Gray, Ifigeneia Rousouli, Edward Gillen, Conrad W Mullineaux, Thomas J Haworth, Christopher D P Duffy
pmc-11413096.description: In the next 10–20 years, several observatories will aim to detect the signatures of oxygenic photosynthesis on exoplanets, though targets must be carefully selected. Most known potentially habitable exo-planets orbit cool M-dwarf stars, which have limited emission in the photosynthetically active region of the spectrum (PAR, 400<λ<700 nm) used by Earth’s oxygenic photoautotrophs.

pmc-11436624.title: Correlating COVID-19 severity with biomarker profiles and patient prognosis
pmc-11436624.creator: R C S Danielle, D M Débora, N L P Alessandra, S S Z Alexia, M C R Débora, N V Elizabel, A M Felipe, M G Giulia, P R Henrique, R M B Karen, S B Layane, A B Leandro, C M Livia, S R T Raquel, S C A Lorena, N R A Lyvia, T R Mariana, C C Matheus, D P V Vinícius, M G Yasmin, D L Iúri
pmc-11436624.description: COVID-19's long-lasting and complex impacts have become a global concern, with diverse clinical outcomes. This study evaluated 226 participants to understand the clinical spectrum of COVID-19/Long COVID (LC), exploring how disease severity correlates with sociodemographic factors and biomarkers. Determinants related to COVID-19 severity included age (P < 0.001), lower education (P < 0.001), ethnicity (P = 0.

pmc-11486887.title: Ultraviolet (UV) radiation: a double-edged sword in cancer development and therapy
pmc-11486887.creator: Zhen-wei Yu, Min Zheng, Hua-yang Fan, Xin-hua Liang, Ya-ling Tang
pmc-11486887.description: It has long been widely acknowledged that ultraviolet (UV) light is an environment risk factor that can lead to cancer, particularly skin cancer. However, it is worth noting that UV radiation holds potential for cancer treatment as a relatively high-energy electromagnetic wave. With the help of nanomaterials, the role of UV radiation has caught increasing attention in cancer treatment.

pmc-11690161.title: MULTISENSORY INTEGRATION IN AGING: LINKS TO MOBILITY
pmc-11690161.creator: Jeannette Mahoney
pmc-11690161.description: Multisensory integration, a rapidly growing field of neuroscience, investigates the simultaneous processing of information from multiple sensory systems. Researchers argue that our brains are designed to simultaneously process information from multiple sensory inputs to produce the most appropriate response to environmental cues.

pmc-13205734.title: Silk Microfiber-Reinforced Biomass Aerogel with Cobweb-like Pore Structure for Highly Efficient Eco-Friendly Air Filtration
pmc-13205734.creator: Kao Wu, Zihan Yu, Zixuan Yang, Yingjie Ding, Hong Qian, Ying Kuang, Man Xiao, Fatang Jiang, Bo Peng
pmc-13205734.description: Airborne particulate matter pollution has posed severe threats to public health, while conventional air filtration materials suffer from non-biodegradability and poor structural stability.
